thread:
maria: Quick q — for the compliance export we're about to ship, do we include full object snapshots or a compact op/diff? need to understand quota/billing impact.
jonathan: We originally leaned full snapshots for context, but those blow up size fast.
nana: (typo) ana: +1 to size concern. full snapshots also raise PII surface area.
tyler: Could we expose a 'sensitivity' flag and let the console choose compact by default? e.g., compact=true for high-volume routes.
kevin: Sampling/compacting might break audit guarantees. compliance often demands exact "who changed what" not an approximation.
maria: Right — requirement: canonical who/when. Possible compromise: keep canonical minimal metadata (actor, timestamp, op type, field path), but avoid full previous/after blobs unless requested.
jonathan: That sounds reasonable. compact op list would be: actor_id, ts, op_type, path, small_delta. No full object.
audit-bot: notice: export_job_123 queued for tenant: acme-corp — estimated_size_bytes=1990000000, items=4.1M
ana: That queued estimate proves the problem. 2GB per export will melt quotas. we need an "export preview" in console showing size + quota hit before users trigger.
tyler: Console UX idea: show two radio options — Compact (recommended) vs Full snapshot — with estimated rows, bytes, and cost. Include a checkbox "include PII" that triggers extra redaction steps.
kevin: Also: exports should not deduct from realtime API quotas. introduce a separate export_quota (daily/export-credits) and throttle by tenant. otherwise a big export can exhaust a customer's runtime capacity and cause outages.
maria: Agreed. Also need an internal API change: export_opts proto with fields: compact:bool, pii_redaction: enum {none, partial, full}, sign:bool, retention:days. who owns API spec?
jonathan: I'll take the API spec. rough proto example:
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "string",
  "since": "2025-12-01T00:00:00Z",
  "export_opts": {
    "compact": true,
    "pii_redaction": "partial",
    "include_actors": "fingerprint_only",
    "sign": true
  }
}
```
nana: Telemetry: emit `export.request` with fields: export_type (compact|full), est_bytes, est_rows, estimation_version, requester, route_policy_id. Also emit `export.started`/`export.completed` with actual_bytes. That will let Optimize produce cost reports.
tyler: Rollout plan: canary compact-only to security-first customers, then console toggle to beta orgs. Dedicated customers get opt-in defaults.
maria: Action items: jonathan spec API + proto PR; kevin draft quota model (export_quota per tenant + billing signals); ana add telemetry events and estimation logic; tyler mock console preview + cost UI; i'll coordinate compliance review. can we target EOD Tue for first drafts?
kevin: :thumbsup: i'll draft quota PR and a rough rate-limiter formula (credits per GB + per-row).
jonathan: I'll drop a proto PR and sample payload to #eng-api tomorrow AM.
nana: I'll wire telemetry to the estimator and post sample dashboard query.
tyler: I'll put up a Figma for the preview modal and share link.
maria: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the audit trail for approvals and decisions. leaving notes here for the comanagers.
kevin: FYI security flagged "include_actors: fingerprint_only" as the default to reduce PII risk. we'll surface the tradeoff in the modal.
jonathan: Noted. will include a schema note about actor pseudonymization.
maria: good. closing for now, will reopen if compliance has follow-ups.
